newsitem.title: FRANCE: RALLYING-MCRAE CLOSES GAP ON SAINZ IN TOUR OF CORSICA.
newsitem.headline: RALLYING-MCRAE CLOSES GAP ON SAINZ IN TOUR OF CORSICA.

text.p: Aggressive driving on dry asphalt roads allowed Briton Colin McRae, in a Subaru Impreza, to close the gap on leader Carlos Sainz in the Tour of Corsica on Wednesday.

McRae, who had started the final day of the rally 22 seconds behind Sainz, in fourth position overall, moved up to second place, 10 seconds adrift of the leader's Ford Escort after four of the final six timed stages.
Gilles Panizzi of France was third, one second behind McRae in a Peugeot 306.
There was disappointment however for Panizzi's team mate Francois Delecour, the overnight joint leader, who dropped to fourth place, 15 seconds behind Sainz.

Delecour claimed the day's first test, a short sprint over 9.6 kms from Bellevalle to Marato. But in the following two sections the Frenchman, hampered by a wrong choice of tyres and clutch problems, lost ground.
McRae, meanwhile, took every conceivable risk, clocking the best time in the last two of the morning's four stretches to stay in contention for victory.
